description:
3DCodeVerse-2M
	

A large-scale corpus of standalone, executable 3D code — Blender Python, CadQuery, GLSL, Three.js, OpenSCAD and URDF — released with the paper
3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code.
